purpose: Curated, evidenced overrides for scripts/refresh_companies_house.py. This answers ^o96: without it, a match cleared by hand is silently re-made by the next nightly name search and the correction undoes itself overnight.
rule:
An `exclude` entry means: NEVER attach this company number to this supplier, by any route — anchored number, website proof, or name search. The supplier falls through to the honest empty state, which is the correct output for thin evidence (root rule 14).
A `correct` entry records a number a curator established against TWO INDEPENDENT SOURCES, listed in `correctSources`. It is treated as route 1 (curator-recorded). It is never a name-search result and must never be added from one.
Companies House aggregators (Endole, Company Check, OpenCorporates, Kompass, D&B) are NOT an independent second source: they are copies of the register, so they restate source 1 (HUB-VERIFICATION-STANDARD.md §6). Same corporate group is not the same company. Two companies sharing a name is not evidence; two sharing a number is.
